decision: Accept as a conditional ordinary mathematical addendum, for compound U and bare b,c,F,top. Bare U=a remains excluded.

finite_value_replay.scope: Finite value identities only; ordinary model argument is in colored_model_addendum.tex.

model_existence.argument: ZFC proves its recursive first-order theory has a set model if its syntactic consistency statement holds, by formalized completeness. No actual Con(ZFC) premise is discharged.

exceptional_objects.argument: Internal A=1 and B={2} are distinct, nonempty, and mutually nonmembers in any ZFC model. Foundation rules out every diagonal membership edge, including in externally ill-founded models.

infinite_quantifiers.argument: Every nonempty family has an attained minimum in the finite four-value chain. The designated implication relation is meet-closed by the supplied four-case minimum argument. The existential and conjunction reductions depend only on designated values.

GIC.argument: For each finite decoded matrix, exact four-value predicates are translated to ordinary first-order formulas of M with parameters A,B. Apply Collection to active domain fibers, followed by Separation to remove unsupported outputs. The designated colored GIC condition is exactly the resulting classical coverage/support condition; colored false membership edges never count as actual members.

CP.argument: Take an ordinary transitive power-container V containing p,A,B. Then V differs from both exceptional columns, so its membership values are only0 or3. This makes colored transitivity valid. Colored Sub_R(z,x)=3 implies ordinary subsethood; the ordinary CP power bound supplies W in V containing all such z. No reverse implication from ordinary subsethood is used.

numerical_collisions.argument: For a=b, CP and GIC coverage antecedents are diagonal membership0. CP still needs a set containing the free root; GIC support is satisfied by the true empty set, whose column has no colored false edges. Gates c=a or c=b emit truth0.

freshness_and_coupled_parameters.argument: For positive code c, source label c is absent from decoded c by the code bound. Code0 is handled by semantic constant-truth independence. The same numerical c serving as matrix code, collection-set binder, and CP root label causes no conflict; separate conjuncts use their own binder scopes. Coincident assigned objects are permitted.

aliases.argument: Code1 is diagonal membership and remains value0 under every binder, including label0. Code0 has value3, so the wim(0,0)=0 alias respects implication. Peirce witness uses positive atomic codes and no zero-code collapse.

recommended_clarifications: Add a sentence deriving ordinary GIC from Collection on the active domain subset followed by Separation; this avoids leaving the schema as an unexplained black box.
Explicitly say code0 freshness here is semantic independence of the constant-truth alias, not literal syntactic absence of label0.
scope_limits: Conditional on Con(ZFC), not unconditional consistency.
Does not cover bare reconstruction U=a at full-theory level.
Establishes failure to recover the original Peirce formulas, not failure of every possible translated interpretation.
No inequiconsistency theorem or new binary TM bound.
Finite auxiliary checker certifies value algebra; the model argument is ordinary mathematics, not a proof-assistant endpoint.
